_about: For solo devs and small studios sharing a game in development: devlogs, playtests, feedback and a wishlist push. Naming: emoji prefix.

channels.name: 👋・welcome
channels.topic: What we're making and how to help.
channels.message:
**Welcome to {server}!** 🎮

We're building a game in the open, and you can shape it.

1. Read {#rules}.
2. Pick your pings in {#get-roles}.
3. Tell us what you'd love to see in {#ideas}.
4. Want to play early? Sign up in {#playtest-signups}.

New builds and devlogs land in {#devlogs} first.

channels.name: 📜・rules
channels.message:
**Rules**

1. Be kind. Criticise the game, never people.
2. **Feedback is gold:** say what you did, what happened and how it felt.
3. Don't share builds, keys or screenshots marked confidential outside the playtest channels.
4. No spam or self-promo outside {#show-your-game}.
5. Moderators have the final say.

channels.name: 📢・devlogs
channels.topic: Devlogs, new builds and release news.

channels.name: 🎭・get-roles
channels.message:
**Pick your pings** (react to get a role, remove the reaction to drop it):

📰 {@Devlog Pings} - new devlogs
🧪 {@Playtest Pings} - playtest invites

channels.name: 💬・general
channels.topic: Chat about the game and games in general.

channels.name: 💡・ideas
channels.topic: One idea per post. React 👍 on ideas you want.
channels.message: One idea per post, with a clear title. Explain the problem it solves, not just the feature.

channels.name: 🎨・fan-art
channels.topic: Art, memes and mods inspired by the game.

channels.name: 🕹️・show-your-game
channels.topic: Fellow devs: share your own project (once a week).

channels.name: 🧪・playtest-signups
channels.topic: Want to playtest? Open a private thread and tell us your platform and specs.
channels.message: **Want to playtest?** Press the Threads button (or +) here, choose **Private Thread**, and tell us your platform, PC specs or device, and how many hours a week you can play. Only you and {@Moderator} can see it.

channels.name: 📦・builds
channels.topic: Latest playtest builds. Don't share outside this channel.
channels.message: Playtest builds are posted here. Please keep them, and screenshots of unreleased content, inside this channel.

channels.name: 🐛・bug-reports
channels.topic: One bug per post: steps, what happened, what you expected, build number.
channels.message: Title: short summary. Then: build number, steps to reproduce, what happened, what you expected. Screenshots or clips help a lot.

channels.name: 🗣️・playtest-feedback
channels.topic: How did it feel? What confused you?

screen.description: Help us build the game: devlogs, playtests and feedback.
